audit.why: 56.33% over 577 games, FAV 6/10 — Olaf owns the lane outright and Poppy reclaims value as a full-build peeler.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf. Three of those neutrals are contradicted directly beneath them — whys[0] says 'you win first contact', whys[3] says his short trades snowball and she has no sustain, whys[4] calls 6 his cleanest all-in window. Meanwhile row 6 is given to Olaf although whys[6] and spikes[3] both say full-build Poppy outscales him and peels the dive.
audit.why: Half of Poppy's kit is dead against a champion with no dashes; the packet chart gives Olaf rows 0-5 and the reversal only comes at full build.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Poppy, with ratings moved. Row 6 is set to Poppy rather than the packet's Skill because both the why and the late-game spike describe a takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: A knockup on Poppy's Q is asserted five times ('her Q-knockup', 'Q knockup interrupting your step-in', 'her E pin, Q knockup and R knockback'). Hammer Shock deals damage and creates a slowing zone that explodes after a delay — there is no knockup on it. Poppy's only displacement is Keeper's Verdict (R). The page also repeats 'R cleanses it' for Ragnarok, which is immunity to disables held while attacking, not a cleanse.
audit.why: The page tells the player to fear a step-in interrupt that does not exist, and never tells him the real Hammer Shock counterplay, which is to step off the zone before the delayed explosion. It also buries the one genuinely decisive fact the page already half-states: Steadfast Presence stops dashes, and Olaf has none, so a fifth of her kit does nothing in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Every 'Q knockup' replaced with Hammer Shock's real behaviour — a 430-range slow zone that explodes on a delay, on 8s at rank 1. Heroic Charge given its 14s and the stun's wall condition, Steadfast Presence its 20s and its dead-weight status here, Keeper's Verdict named as the 140s interruptible channel. Ragnarok restated as immunity held while attacking, pressed as Heroic Charge lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Heroic Charge' eight times, no duration anywhere.
audit.why: Heroic Charge at 14s rank 1 is the only thing in her kit that can stop the run-down, and only against a wall.
audit.corrected: 14s and 20s written into the cooldown breakdown and the all-in window, with the wall condition attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Poppy referred to as 'he/his' in the full layer's trade and feeding lines.
audit.corrected: Fixed in dontsFull[0].d, which is one of the lines being rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannot verify whether Ragnarok's disable immunity covers Keeper's Verdict's knockback.
audit.why: Riot's text does not separate displacement from disable; needsResearch is empty by design.
audit.corrected: Dropped the R-knockback claim rather than reversing it; nothing asserted in its place. See unverified.

notes: Main correction: the page invents a knockup on Poppy's Q in five places. Hammer Shock is a 430-range slow zone that explodes after a delay — the counterplay is to step off it, which the page never said. Her only displacement is Keeper's Verdict. I also promoted the one genuinely decisive fact the page mentioned only in passing: Steadfast Presence stops dashes and Olaf has none, so a fifth of her kit is dead in this matchup — that now sits in the tldr. Removed the claim that Ragnarok blanks her R knockback (displacement vs disable is not stated in Riot's text) and corrected 'R cleanses it' to immunity held while attacking. Chart flipped four rows in matched pairs. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding; Riot's description is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only, so no grounding claim written.
